name: Texas Brigades Camps (Cadet)
city: Camps across Texas (Rising Star, La Pryor, McCoy, Freer, Bonham, Garwood, Santa Anna, Anahuac)
what_you_do: Spend five days at a wildlife and land stewardship leadership camp. Past camps covered bobwhite quail, deer, bass, ranching, waterfowl and coastal wildlife.
who_can_apply: Ages 13 to 17, from incoming 8th graders to incoming seniors. Apply as a Cadet. Past camp graduates can later apply as Assistant Leaders.
pay_detail: Total camp price not stated on the program pages. A $100 non-refundable deposit, applied to the camp fee, is due May 15. The site says tuition help is available. Email camps@texasbrigades.org.
deadline_text: 2027 applications are available now and are due March 15, 2027 at 11:59 PM. The 2027 camps run June 9 to July 31.
how_to_apply: Complete the online application in one sitting, with two essay questions and a list of achievements. Rank your top three camp choices.
notes: Camp phone 210-556-1391. Assistant Leaders can earn college scholarships. Camps listed for 2027 include Bobwhite, Buckskin, Ranch, Bass, Waterfowl and Coastal Brigades, plus a North Dakota Waterfowl Brigade at Fort Ransom, ND.
